Documentation / Project

Agent operating manual

Operating manual for AI coding agents and new contributors working in this repository. README.md provides orientation for human readers; this file defines the rules and procedures. Where an explicit user instruction conflicts with this file, the user instruction takes precedence.

Project

Vodka is a native macOS application that runs Steam and Windows games on Apple Silicon (a fork of Whisky via frankea's community fork). Toolchain: Swift 6, SwiftUI, macOS 15 or later, Xcode 16 or later.

Related repositories in the ecosystem live in separate Git repositories (typically cloned as siblings under a common parent directory):

  • rolling7ho/winecx: patched Wine/CrossOver source tree (d3dmetal-errno branch).
  • rolling7ho/dxmt: patched DXMT source tree (teardown branch) for vodkametal.
  • rolling7ho/openv: open-source single-player ScriptHookV replacement for GTA V Enhanced.

Repository map

Path Role Notes
Vodka/ SwiftUI application target New files require entries in Vodka.xcodeproj.
VodkaKit/ Swift package containing the logic: Wine, bottles, Steam, library, playtime SwiftPM discovers new files automatically. Tests reside here.
VodkaCmd/ Command-line interface used by Dock shortcuts to launch games
VodkaThumbnail/ Quick Look thumbnail extension for .exe files
VodkaUITests/ XCUITest suite for the application Fixture-dependent tests skip when no bottle exists.
scripts/ Build, release, localization and secret-scan helpers
docs/ Dependency, release and troubleshooting documentation Runtime pins must match docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
runtime/ Local Wine runtime build driver and notes Local lanes (runtime-*, pkg-*, deps/) remain untracked.
.build/ DerivedData and SwiftPM output Never commit. VodkaKit/.build is ignored separately.

Environment

  • Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 15 or later, Xcode 16 or later (swift --version should report Swift 6).
  • swiftlint, which runs automatically as an Xcode build phase; violations fail the build.
  • swiftformat 0.58.7, the version CI downloads. Homebrew's swiftformat is usually newer than that pin; verify swiftformat --version and install the 0.58.7 release if --lint reports differences that CI does not.
  • trufflehog for scripts/scan-secrets.sh (brew install trufflehog).

Commands

Run commands from the repository root.

Build, test, install

# Build the application (Debug, unsigned, with the codesign flags CI uses)
xcodebuild -project Vodka.xcodeproj -scheme Vodka -configuration Debug build \
  -derivedDataPath .build/debug \
  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

# Build every scheme, as CI does
for scheme in Vodka VodkaCmd VodkaThumbnail; do
  xcodebuild -project Vodka.xcodeproj -scheme "$scheme" -configuration Debug build \
    CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
done

# Release build, ad-hoc signed, installed to /Applications
scripts/install-local.sh

# Unit tests (VodkaKit); fast, run for any logic change
swift test --package-path VodkaKit

# A single suite or test
swift test --package-path VodkaKit --filter CommandKeyMappingTests

# UI tests (slow; run only when UI behaviour changed)
xcodebuild -project Vodka.xcodeproj -scheme Vodka -configuration Debug \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:VodkaUITests test \
  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

Style, strings, secrets

swiftformat --lint .                     # check; fix with: swiftformat .
swiftlint --strict                      # configuration: .swiftlint.yml
./scripts/british-english.py --check    # en-GB must cover every en key
./scripts/scan-secrets.sh               # same check as CI (TruffleHog)

Direct3D 12 layer

scripts/build-vodka-d3d12.sh [dxmt-checkout-path]

Defaults to VODKA_DXMT_DIR or ../dxmt with its toolchains/ directory present. Stages DLLs into build/vodka-d3d12/.

Architecture and boundaries

  • Layering. UI and application lifecycle code belongs in Vodka/; Wine, bottle, Steam, library and playtime logic belongs in VodkaKit. Testable logic belongs in VodkaKit, not in views.
  • Game fixes are data. A fix that only changes Windows settings for one game belongs in VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/GameDatabase/Resources/GameDB.json, with a reference to the origin of the fix. Games must not be special-cased in Swift.
  • Runtime is downloaded, not vendored. The application fetches Libraries.tar.gz according to VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/Utils/DistributionConfig.swift. Runtime binaries must never be added to the repository. Runtime pins live in .github/workflows/RuntimeTrack.yml and must remain in sync with docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
  • Localization. New user-facing strings are added to Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings in English only, edited as text with only the required lines touched. Re-saving the file with a JSON tool reorders the catalog. Run scripts/british-english.py afterwards to regenerate en-GB.
  • Xcode project. Files added to the application target (Vodka/) require Vodka.xcodeproj entries, while VodkaKit discovers files automatically. Adding those entries for a new source file is expected and is the only project.pbxproj edit permitted (see hard rule 2).
  • Generated site. dist/pages/ holds the published site. The page and stylesheet are edited as source; the appcast is written by scripts/publish-update.sh and the documentation pages under dist/pages/docs/ by scripts/build-docs-site.py. Publish by copying the directory to the gh-pages branch. Do not edit appcast.xml by hand.

Code conventions

  • Every Swift file begins with the GPL header ("This file is part of Vodka, a fork of Whisky."). file_header is an error-level SwiftLint rule; copy the header from an existing file.
  • SwiftFormat configuration: 4-space indent, maximum width 120, --guardelse next-line, alphabetical import grouping, no semicolons. redundantSelf is disabled, so explicit self is preserved; do not remove it by hand. Run the formatter rather than matching style manually.
  • SwiftLint enables force_unwrapping; do not add ! unwraps in new code.
  • Prefer existing patterns (bottle abstractions, the Bottle and Wine types, swift-testing suites for new tests) over new abstractions or dependencies. Ask before adding a package.
  • VodkaKit tests are mixed: XCTest and swift-testing (@Test, struct ...Tests) coexist. New tests use swift-testing, and existing XCTest files are not ported as incidental churn. VodkaUITests uses XCTest throughout.
  • Changelog: describe user-facing changes under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md.
  • Commit messages are imperative and scoped, for example vodka: fix Steam launch resolver or docs: update the README.

Writing and communication

One register applies to all text produced in this repository or in conversation with the maintainer, unless an explicit instruction states otherwise. Do not require the user to ask for it.

Scope. The policy covers:

  • documentation, README files, plans, ADRs and design notes;
  • pull request titles, descriptions, review comments and issue replies;
  • commit messages and code comments;
  • every response to the maintainer, including short status updates, questions and summaries of work.

Register.

  • Use complete sentences and state the fact or the action directly.
  • Do not use contractions, em-dash asides, exclamation marks or decorative emoji.
  • Do not use marketing superlatives, and do not assert claims the repository cannot substantiate. Quantify only values that were measured.
  • Use the imperative mood for instructions, the present tense for descriptions, and "must" or "do not" for requirements.
  • Use one term per concept and do not alternate synonyms for the same object.
  • Prefer the concrete path, command or symbol to a paraphrase of it.

Exceptions. An explicit user instruction to write briefly or informally overrides this section for that response only.

Testing guidance

  • Logic change: swift test --package-path VodkaKit, with --filter for the affected suite.
  • Application or UI change: build the affected scheme; run VodkaUITests only when the interaction itself changed.
  • Strings or localization: scripts/british-english.py --check.
  • Formatting and lint: swiftformat --lint . and swiftlint --strict.
  • CI-only checks (coverage upload, Codecov, gh-pages) may be skipped locally.
  • Never weaken, skip or delete a test to obtain a passing run. Fix the cause and report anything that could not be run.

Git workflow

  • Every change goes through a pull request by default. This applies to all work, including code, documentation, configuration and one-line fixes. Do not wait for the user to request a pull request or to point out that one is needed: branch, push the branch, open the pull request and report its URL as part of completing the task.

  • Never push to main directly. Do not git push to main, do not push a branch that is then fast-forwarded into main by hand, and do not merge a pull request without explicit user approval. The standard procedure:

    git switch -c vodka/short-description
# edit, then run the checks in the verification table
git add <explicit paths>
git commit -m "vodka: fix Steam launch resolver"
git push -u origin vodka/short-description
gh pr create --fill --base main

    Run the checks yourself rather than treating a green merge button as evidence.

  • Delete the branch after every pull request. Once the pull request merges, remove the remote branch with git push origin --delete <branch> and the local branch with git branch -d <branch>, then run git fetch --prune to drop stale remote-tracking references. A pull request that is closed without merging is cleaned up the same way.

  • Stage explicit paths rather than git add -A when untracked runtime lanes or local build artifacts are present.

Hard rules

  1. Do not commit runtime build outputs (runtime/runtime-*, runtime/pkg-*, runtime/deps, .build/, *.tar.gz, logs, or machine-specific artifacts).
  2. Do not edit generated files by hand: dist/pages/docs/, the formatting of Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings, or *.xcodeproj internals. The one permitted Vodka.xcodeproj edit is adding the file references and build-phase entries that a new application-target source file requires.
  3. Do not introduce secrets, API keys, certificates or provisioning profiles. The Sparkle signing key resides in the maintainer's keychain (vodka account) and must never be placed in the repository.
  4. Do not run destructive commands (git reset --hard, git clean -xdf) unless the user explicitly requests that exact action.
  5. Do not add a dependency or a new top-level directory without asking.
  6. Do not push to main, and do not consider a change complete until it is on a branch with an open pull request. Only the merge into main waits for the user to ask.
  7. Write in the formal technical register defined under Writing and communication. The policy applies to every document, plan, ADR, pull request comment and reply to the maintainer, and requires no reminder from the user.

Verification before finishing

You changed Run at least
VodkaKit logic swift test --package-path VodkaKit --filter <suite>
Application or UI build the Vodka scheme; VodkaUITests if interaction changed
User-facing strings ./scripts/british-english.py --check
Swift style swiftformat --lint . && swiftlint --strict
Documentation only check links and paths; builds may be skipped

Report exactly which checks ran, their result, and any check that could not be run. Compiling is not equivalent to testing behaviour.

Known pitfalls

  • SwiftLint is skipped silently in Xcode when CI=true is set, so a local build can pass while CI fails. Run swiftlint --strict explicitly.
  • en-GB must be complete. A single missing string causes macOS to display the raw key to British users. Regenerate it after modifying Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings.
  • The application bundle must ship winetricks, verbs.txt and cabextract. CI asserts on the built artifact because the copy phase can omit them without failing.
